selection.name: Portfolio Model Family Workspace Entry Point
selection.goal: Expose the verified portfolio model-family HTML as a direct backward-compatible download entry point and dedicated offline workspace card, without changing release contents, source data or comparison semantics.

rationale: the immutable v1.12.0 release is complete and publicly byte-verified
the family HTML already exists in the verified archive
the current consumer path reaches it only indirectly through cross-model navigation
a direct optional entry point improves discoverability without changing product semantics
older immutable releases can remain valid because the new entry point is optional
preserved_boundaries: no source or master data changes
